A few clues. Room to discover.

There isn’t enough of a pattern to suggest a field yet. Try a few different activities first.

What matters to me
Welcome variety
Clues I can build on
My next three steps
Try two different activities

This week, spend 15–20 minutes on two different things: make a visual idea, solve a practical puzzle, or help someone learn. Pick what is easy to access. Notice what you want to try again.

Target date · optional
